MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink bundle and Alexa lighting kit give my existing home setup new uses: camera security beyond my door alarms and voice-controlled lighting beyond speakers.",
    "The USB adapters fit my history of buying practical peripherals and connection accessories, provided they match the ports on my devices."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Echo Dot and Fire TV Stick repeat functions covered by my recently purchased fourth-generation Dot, Echo Show and Fire TV Stick 4K Max. Even the Dot with a clock feels useful but unnecessary right now.",
    "The internal SSD, computer case and power supply assume an upgrade or building project I have not shown interest in; my storage and computer purchases have mostly been ready-to-use accessories.",
    "The tablet and earbuds do not address a current need evident in my purchases, even though they are electronics."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying several Alexa devices seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest more speakers and streaming devices, regardless of what I already have.",
    "My interest in computer accessories seems to have been stretched into an interest in internal components and computer building."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter: another device needs to add a useful capability to justify overlapping with equipment I just bought.",
    "Compatibility matters for accessories; buying keyboards, mice and adapters does not establish that I have USB-C ports or a computer that accepts an internal SSD.",
    "My replacement batteries and device stands suggest that supporting equipment I already own can be more relevant than adding another main device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa and practical electronics, but miss the difference between extending my setup and duplicating it or assuming a new project."
}
